description:
Blog & News CMS — list, read, create, update, publish/unpublish or delete blog posts on a website. Published posts appear automatically in blog-grid blocks and at /blog/[slug] on the live site. Post bodies accept plain text (blank lines become paragraphs) or simple HTML (

,

,

    , , ,
    ). Make sure a page on the site has a "blog-grid" block so visitors can find posts.

authorName.description: Byline shown on the post, e.g. "Newsroom" or a reporter name

body.description: Post body — plain text or simple HTML

coverImageUrl.description: Cover image URL (use manage_media(action="upload_url") or manage_media(action="generate") first if needed)

excerpt.description: 1–2 sentence summary shown on cards and search engines

publish.description: create/update: true = publish now, false = unpublish to draft

slug.description: URL slug — derived from the title when omitted

name: manage_posts
